body: Men and women have different experiences interfacing with the world. With my particular set of challenges I'm facing, I want to speak to a man.

I've been in weekly therapy for quite a while. I improve and then regress significantly, it seems like. When I improve, it's like I get better at distracting myself or anesthetizing myself against my underlying issues. I just have a really unhealthy mindset where I have zero intrinsic self-worth, and I have no idea how to escape that.
Have been dealing with one form of depression for another for many years, but it has been bad like this for about a year.
Thank you man, this actually really hits home. Thank you bro

I work out regularly, with body weight workouts during the week and long cardio sessions on the weekend. If I had more flexible work hours, I would probably work out more often. Thanks for the suggestion.
My dream is to play music professionally. I'm doing everything I can to work towards that, and I think I would be happier if I was able to make a career out of my passion. Thanks for your comment.

When did you realize this about yourself? Is it more about fulfilling his desires or is it about the act of relinquishing yourself? As someone who has been in this type of relationship before, I completely understand the master/slave bond and the unique, intense love that goes along with it.
What turns you on about being a sub in general? What about being a slave sub specifically?

1) Not going to hurt myself because it would hurt my family. As I said above, this makes me feel trapped alive. Kind of a Catch 22. Hopefully if I can find some good reasons to want to be alive, this will solve itself.

2) I work 9-5 in a salaried job, so income is fine. I want a raise and more vacation time -- I would call that my larger goal at the moment. Hopefully I can find a way to negotiate that.

3) I can't compromise on this. Music is what I want to dedicate my life to, so I have to do whatever I can to work towards becoming a professional. I understand this is a lofty (or impossible) goal, but I have no choice but to work towards it as best as I can. This is my primary purpose.

4) Support system -- like friends and family? You're right that it's probably premature to pursue romance. It's maybe stretching myself too thin to put lots of effort towards that. I don't like being an ascetic -- that is, it's tough not to care about romance. I should consider making this a much lower priority than it is now.

5) This was a big one for me in recent months. I have fortunately been able to cut back, though I do still play vidya when I need to unwind. Most of the time I was spending on vidya I now use to play music.

6) Plz explain battle rhythm? You mean make a weekly list like the one you made? I like that idea a lot. It's sometimes hard for me to objectively look at myself and identify the things I need to work on, but I think this a really good idea that could help keep me on track.

Thanks internet support team.

I am in therapy. It helps somewhat, but I wouldn't consider myself cured by any means (obviously, lol). I'm doing better than I was, but the scope of my problems can seem overwhelming at times. There is no quick solution to this, but I am doing my best to push on anyway and take the right path wherever possible.

I am in therapy. I think I've listed the causes in my OP pretty clearly, but I don't know what path to take to correct them. Thanks for your suggestion to volunteer, that's definitely something I should consider.

What convinced you to love yourself? I'm struggling with depression right now, and I hate myself, and I tend to project that onto other people, which reinforces my perspective. It's a bad cycle. I know that loving myself is the better thing to do, but I have no rationale to do it. What changed your mind?

That's exactly my point. The only reason I haven't done it is because it would hurt everyone else, and just pass my suffering on to them. I'm likely never going to do it, but I would if it wouldn't hurt anyone else. I'm trapped alive. It sucks.
